tokens.name: color-bg
tokens.usage: Canvas behind the plan page and the well of text fields. `color-ink` reads on it at 13.8:1 (light) / 13.0:1 (dark).

tokens.name: color-surface
tokens.usage: Cards (panel, popover, Square chip), buttons, the side panel, and the halo behind on-plan labels.

tokens.name: color-paper
tokens.usage: The plot plan page and the fill of corner dots. Stays white in dark mode because the PDF is drawn on white.

tokens.name: color-ink
tokens.usage: Body text and button labels on `color-surface` (16.6:1 light, 11.1:1 dark) and `color-bg`.

tokens.name: color-muted
tokens.usage: Hints, field labels, layer sub-lines (plot area), a hidden plan’s eye and the Snap toggle when off. On `color-surface` 5.8:1 / 5.6:1; on `color-bg` 4.8:1 / 6.5:1.

tokens.name: color-line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders on buttons, inputs and cards. Decorative only: 1.5:1 / 1.3:1 against `color-surface`, below 3:1 — cards are also set apart by `shadow-lg`, buttons by their label.

tokens.name: color-accent
tokens.usage: The one primary action per card, focus rings, the pressed Snap toggle border, the selected-corner ring. 7.5:1 / 6.6:1 on `color-surface`.

tokens.name: color-on-accent
tokens.usage: Label on a `color-accent` fill (7.5:1 light, 8.4:1 dark). Dark mode flips to dark text because the accent lightens.

tokens.name: color-ok
tokens.usage: Success states, always paired with words, never colour alone. (Nothing on screen uses it right now.)

tokens.name: color-warn
tokens.usage: Out of tolerance, form errors, and the Delete button's label. Orange, not red, so it stays distinct from `color-ok` by lightness as well as hue.

tokens.name: color-shadow
tokens.usage: Base of every shadow token (used at 12–30% alpha).

tokens.name: color-inverse-bg
tokens.usage: Toast and edge-length tip background: an inverse bubble so it reads over any part of the plan.

tokens.name: color-inverse-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `color-inverse-bg` (13.8:1 / 13.0:1).

tokens.name: color-boundary
tokens.usage: The plot boundary outline, its corners, bend handles and the selected-edge highlight. 5.1:1 on the white page (4.8:1 for the dark-mode value).

tokens.name: color-feature
tokens.usage: An existing feature while it is being drawn, and its stroke and label when selected.

tokens.name: color-feature-fill
tokens.usage: Grey fill of a closed existing feature (house, driveway…), drawn at `opacity-feature-fill`. Also the halo colour behind feature names.

tokens.name: color-feature-stroke
tokens.usage: Thin outline of an unselected existing feature.

tokens.name: color-feature-ink
tokens.usage: Feature name on its fill (6.8:1 light, 5.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: color-snap
tokens.usage: The point being placed: ring, crosshair, magnifier crosshair, snap marks and their labels ("Corner", "On line", "45°"). 4.5:1 on white; FLAG: 2.9:1 on the dark-mode `color-surface` halo — labels sit on the white plan, so they read, but the halo pair fails.

tokens.name: color-guide
tokens.usage: Hints that never snap: 90° corner mark, "Straight", dashed alignment lines. FLAG: 4.1:1 on white and 3.3:1 on the dark halo — below 4.5:1 for its 13px labels; kept as built.

tokens.name: color-material-sod
tokens.usage: Sod surface fill (with its pattern). Same in dark mode: zones sit on the white plan.

tokens.name: color-material-turf
tokens.usage: Artificial turf surface fill (with its pattern). Same in dark mode: zones sit on the white plan.

tokens.name: color-material-mulch
tokens.usage: Mulch surface fill (with its pattern). Same in dark mode: zones sit on the white plan.

tokens.name: color-material-river-rock
tokens.usage: River rock surface fill (with its pattern). Same in dark mode: zones sit on the white plan.

tokens.name: color-material-decorative-rock
tokens.usage: Decorative rock surface fill (with its pattern). Same in dark mode: zones sit on the white plan.

tokens.name: color-material-gravel

tokens.name: color-material-pavers
tokens.usage: Pavers surface fill (with its pattern). Same in dark mode: zones sit on the white plan.

tokens.name: color-material-flagstone
tokens.usage: Flagstone surface fill (with its pattern). Same in dark mode: zones sit on the white plan.

tokens.name: color-material-concrete-brushed
tokens.usage: Brushed concrete surface fill (with its pattern). Same in dark mode: zones sit on the white plan.

tokens.name: color-material-concrete-stamped
tokens.usage: Stamped concrete surface fill (with its pattern). Same in dark mode: zones sit on the white plan.

tokens.name: color-material-decking
tokens.usage: Decking surface fill (with its pattern). Same in dark mode: zones sit on the white plan.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Tap each corner of the plot boundary.
styles.usage: Panel instructions, buttons and inputs (`text-lg`). The working size: readable at arm's length on a tablet outdoors.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Figures row and toast (`text-base`); digits are tabular.

styles.name: hint
styles.sample: Drag the square in the middle of the edge to curve it.
styles.usage: Hints, field labels, errors (`text-sm`), in `color-muted` or `color-warn`.

styles.name: feature-name
styles.usage: Existing feature name, centred in its shape, haloed in `color-feature-fill`.

styles.name: plan-label
styles.usage: Snap and guide labels next to the point (`text-xs`), haloed in `color-surface`.
